Values._comment_whatsapp: WhatsApp Cloud API credentials - issued by WhatsApp Business Manager. WHATSAPP_WABA_ID is reserved for future media-upload paths and is not required for sending templated messages today.
Values._comment_whatsapp_webhook: WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN is an operator-chosen string that must match the Verify Token you paste into Meta's Webhook configuration. WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET is the Meta App Secret (Settings → Basic in the Meta App), used to HMAC-verify incoming webhook payloads.
Values._comment_smtp: Gmail SMTP for transactional emails. SMTP_PASS is a 16-char App Password (NOT the Google account password). Steps to generate: 1) Sign in to the Gmail account at https://myaccount.google.com 2) Turn on 2-Step Verification under Security 3) Open https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords 4) Generate a new password for 'Mail' / 'Other (Srilatha Art Function App)' 5) Paste the 16-character value as SMTP_PASS without spaces. The account password itself must NEVER be used here.
Values._comment_azure_openai: Both endpoint forms are accepted (the code auto-detects the surface): https://<resource>.openai.azure.com  OR  https://<resource>.services.ai.azure.com/openai/v1
